app.name: Invitation System
app.tagline: Create event invitations, send them to guests and track RSVPs

auth.noAccessBody: {email} is logged in but is not registered as staff. Ask an admin to add you.

admin.noEvents: No events yet. Create the first one.
admin.guests: {count, plural, =0 {0 guests} one {1 guest} other {# guests}}
admin.deleteConfirm: Delete "{title}"? All invitees and RSVPs will be deleted. This cannot be undone.
admin.invitees: {count, plural, =0 {No invitees} one {1 invitee} other {# invitees}}
admin.inviteesComingSoon: The guest list and invitation sending arrive in stages 3-4.
admin.publicLinkClosed: The general link is closed for this event. Only invitees with a personal link can RSVP.

eventForm.title: Event name
eventForm.descriptionPlaceholder: Text shown on the invitation under the title
eventForm.coordinatesHelp: Optional. In Google Maps, right-click the venue to see latitude and longitude.
eventForm.mediaHelp: JPG, PNG, WebP or GIF up to 10MB
eventForm.reminderHours: {count, plural, =0 {No reminder} =24 {1 day before} =48 {2 days before} =72 {3 days before} =168 {1 week before} other {# hours before}}
eventForm.rsvpDeadlineHelp: Optional. The form closes after this time.
eventForm.maxGuestsHelp: Optional. The form closes when the limit is reached.
eventForm.slugHelp: Address of the general link. Lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens. Generated automatically, can be changed.
eventForm.isActive: Event is active (invitation page is open)

errors.invalidSlug: 3 to 40 characters: lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens
errors.slugTaken: This address is taken, choose another
errors.invalidUrl: Invalid link, must start with http

eventForm.invitationMessageHelp: Sent by email and WhatsApp. '{name}' is replaced with the invitee name and '{link}' with their personal link.
eventForm.invitationMessagePlaceholder: Hi '{name}', we would love to see you at our event! RSVP here: '{link}'
eventForm.allowPublicLink: General link open (anyone with the link can RSVP, even without a personal invite)
